desc:
🎨 WELCOME TO FACEPAINTING!!!

🖌️ Draw and design your own custom face directly in-game, then upload it straight to Roblox as UGC!

✅ All in-game purchases are added to your Roblox inventory and can be used on your avatar across all games!

⚠️ Please make sure all uploads follow Roblox’s Terms of Service!

UGC must pass Roblox moderation before it can be worn. UGC uploaded in-game cannot be put on sale!

🔁 Share Codes
Share codes are the same as the catalog ID of your UGC!

🖼️ Decal Importing
The recommended decal size is 512x512!

🖱️ Keybinds
Pencil: V
Brush: B
Airbrush: A
Eraser: E
Smudge: S
Bucket Fill: G
Eyedropper: Q
Select: R
Shape: L
Move: M
Reflect: F
Scale: C
Rotate: T

Toggle Symmetry: X
Toggle Lasso Mode/Axis Lock: D
Toggle Alpha Lock: N
Increase/Decrease Brush Size: [ ]

Thumbnail credits in alt text!
